items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did he go to Professor Chalini too? [INTERVIEWEE] No, he went to a woman teacher, some woman teacher.

ctx.x: Well, he's still interested in music, because he have organ, he, he, he, he, he have organ, he got piano, everything in the house. He works on a ship. Well, yeah.
Did he go to Professor Chalini too?
No, he went to a woman teacher, some woman teacher.
